name.zh: Left 4 Dead 2 专用服务器回归任务

description.en: Ten source-only repository-debugging tasks evaluated by private assertions in a pinned real Left 4 Dead 2 dedicated server.
description.zh: 十个源码级仓库调试任务，由私有断言在固定版本的真实 Left 4 Dead 2 专用服务器中评测。

title.en: Repair L4D2 Competitive Rework release regressions
title.zh: 修复 L4D2 Competitive Rework 发布回归

summary.en: Repair three gameplay and lifecycle regressions in a large SourceMod collection.
summary.zh: 修复大型 SourceMod 插件集合中的三个玩法与生命周期回归。

brief.en: Diagnose every reported regression while preserving unaffected plugin behavior.
brief.zh: 诊断所有报告的回归，同时保持未受影响的插件行为。

en: Fix all three reported regressions.
Keep the submission source-only.
zh: 修复全部三个报告的回归。
保持提交仅包含源码。

en: Preserve the existing SourceMod, Left4DHooks, Confogl, and Director contracts.
zh: 保持现有 SourceMod、Left4DHooks、Confogl 与 Director 合同。

en: All 20 private real-server cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 20 个私有真实服务器用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

title.zh: 修复 Left4DHooks 公共 API 回归

summary.en: Repair twelve pointer, ABI, detour, entity, and lifecycle regressions.
summary.zh: 修复十二个指针、ABI、detour、实体与生命周期回归。

brief.en: Restore every reported public API and forward contract without broad rewrites.
brief.zh: 恢复所有报告的公共 API 与 forward 合同，避免大范围重写。

en: Fix all twelve reported regressions.
Preserve unaffected native and forward behavior.
zh: 修复全部十二个报告的回归。
保持未受影响的 native 与 forward 行为。

en: Keep the public Left4DHooks include declarations aligned with runtime natives.
zh: 保持 Left4DHooks 公共 include 声明与运行时 native 一致。

en: All 71 private ABI and real-server cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 71 个私有 ABI 与真实服务器用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

title.en: Repair L4D Infected Bots release regressions
title.zh: 修复 L4D Infected Bots 发布回归

summary.en: Repair capacity, configuration, spawn-timing, and finale lifecycle regressions.
summary.zh: 修复容量、配置、出生计时与终局生命周期回归。

brief.en: Restore all four observable contracts in the supplied SourceMod project.
brief.zh: 恢复所提供 SourceMod 项目中的全部四个可观察合同。

en: Fix all four reported regression groups.
Keep public native declarations compatible.
zh: 修复全部四组报告的回归。
保持公共 native 声明兼容。

en: Preserve existing SourceMod and Left4DHooks integration.
zh: 保持现有 SourceMod 与 Left4DHooks 集成。

en: All 18 private source and real-server cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 18 个私有源码与真实服务器用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

title.zh: 修复 LinGe VScript 发布回归

summary.en: Repair nine cross-subsystem regressions in a server-side Squirrel project.
summary.zh: 修复服务器端 Squirrel 项目中的九个跨子系统回归。

brief.en: Diagnose every operator report while preserving event-driven behavior.
brief.zh: 诊断所有服务器运营者报告，同时保持事件驱动行为。

en: Fix all nine regression groups.
Do not replace event handling with per-tick health polling.
zh: 修复全部九组回归。
不得用逐 tick 血量轮询替代事件处理。

en: Preserve the existing L4D2 VScript addon entrypoint and event contracts.
zh: 保持现有 L4D2 VScript addon 入口与事件合同。

en: All 42 private Squirrel VM cases must pass in the real server without network access.
zh: 全部 42 个私有 Squirrel VM 用例必须在无网络真实服务器中通过。

title.zh: 修复 Mutant Tanks 发布回归

summary.en: Repair nine core, reward, ability, and lifecycle regressions.
summary.zh: 修复九个核心、奖励、能力与生命周期回归。

brief.en: Restore every reported contract in the frozen Mutant Tanks source tree.
brief.zh: 恢复固定 Mutant Tanks 源码树中的所有报告合同。

en: Fix all nine reported regression groups.
Preserve unaffected configuration and ability behavior.
zh: 修复全部九组报告的回归。
保持未受影响的配置与能力行为。

en: Keep the documented Mutant Tanks forwards and SourceMod integration compatible.
zh: 保持已记录的 Mutant Tanks forward 与 SourceMod 集成兼容。

en: All 57 private source and real-server cases must pass without network access.
zh: 全部 57 个私有源码与真实服务器用例必须在无网络环境中通过。

summary.en: Repair activation snapshots, reentrant enforcement, late binding and release.

en: Preserve the plugin’s existing SourceMod public natives, forwards and commands.
